derivation:
by
  intro i _
  simpa [torusMap, Complex.circleMap, closedPolydisc] using Complex.circleMap_mem_closedBall (c i) hR (θ i)
explanation: Mathlib’s lemma says the complex circle parametrization at any nonnegative radius lies in the corresponding closed ball. Each coordinate of `torusMap c (fun _ => R) θ` is that circle parametrization; unfolding the polydisc definition gives the required coordinatewise membership. The current proof establishes this directly by simplification.
